name: Planning Commission Regular Meeting Notice of Continuance and Adjournment (PDF)
agenda_text:
City of Alhambra

  NOTICE OF CONTINUANCE
  AND ADJOURNMENT
  OF THE
  JULY 20, 2026 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  (Notice No. N2M26-92)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
Planning Commission scheduled for 7:00 p.m., Monday, July 20, 2026, in
the Council Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall is hereby ADJOURNED and
the Public Hearing (Agenda Item 6) is hereby CONTINUED to the next regularly
scheduled meeting of the Alhambra Planning Commission, as specified below,
pursuant to the order of the Planning Commission Secretary.

THE ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE ALHAMBRA PLANNING
COMMISSION WILL BE HELD ON MONDAY, AUGUST 17, 2026,
COMMENCING AT 7:00 P.M. IN THE ALHAMBRA CITY HALL, COUNCIL
CHAMBERS, 111 SOUTH FIRST STREET, ALHAMBRA, CA.

MAIA MCCURLEY
PLANNING COMMISSION SECRETARY

Dated:  July 20, 2026
Notice No.  N2M26-92
Posted:  July 20, 2026
